DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの果実は、いつ落ちた物ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝七時に拾いました。ただ、落ちる瞬間は見ていません。七時に落ちたと書くのは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った時刻は落下目撃時刻ではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-02.translation: I picked it up at seven this morning. But I did not see it fall, so it would be wrong to write that it fell at seven.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Make clear that the pickup time is not the time you witnessed it fall. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発見時刻として記録してください。どの木の下でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-03.translation: Record it as the discovery time. Under which tree was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番の木の下です。隣の木から転がったかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見位置と元の木の不明を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-04.translation: Under tree three. I do not know whether it rolled from the neighboring tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the discovery location from the unknown source tree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 位置と、確認できた状態を分けましょう。通常の収穫分と混ぜていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate location from the condition you confirmed. Have you mixed it with the regular harvest?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 混ぜていません。落果用の籠に六個あります。木から取った果実ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 落果六個を木上収穫分と混ぜていないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. There are six in the fallen-fruit basket. They were not picked from the trees.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say six fallen fruits have not been mixed with tree-picked fruit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この後の扱いは担当が確認します。ご自身で洗って収穫用の箱へ戻さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will decide how to handle them next. Do not wash them yourself and return them to the harvest box.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。土が付いた物もあります。その見た目を残して、担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付着状態を変えず担当の扱いを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Some have soil on them. I will preserve their appearance and wait for the person responsible to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave the attached material unchanged and wait for the responsible person's handling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録には発見した数と位置と時刻を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-09.translation: Enter the number found, location and time in the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六個、三番の木の下、七時に発見と書きます。落下した時刻と元の木は未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数位置発見時刻と未確認項目を分けて記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write six, under tree three, discovered at seven. The time of falling and original tree are unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the count, location and discovery time separately from unconfirmed points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その記録で担当へ渡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-010-001-SHARED-11.translation: Give that record to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今週の販売報告はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is this week's sales report.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十袋、二千円とあります。今日受け取るお金が二千円ということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 販売総額を当日精算金か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says ten bags, two thousand yen. Does that mean I receive two thousand yen today?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the total sales amount is today's settlement payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは販売の総額です。精算する額は、委託時の条件と明細で別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is total sales. We check the settlement amount separately against the consignment conditions and breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 販売数と販売額の報告ですね。手数料の欄も見ずに、総額を受取額と思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数額報告と手数料後の受取額を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it reports the sales count and sales amount. I mistook the total for my payment without looking at the commission field.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the count and amount report from payment after commission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 精算明細を担当が説明します。売れなかった分の扱いもご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will explain the settlement statement. Would you also like to check the unsold items?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。納品は十二袋だったので、残り二袋の所在を確認したいです。差の二袋を廃棄と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 納品との差二袋は所在未確認で廃棄とは限らないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I delivered twelve bags, so I want to check where the remaining two are. I will not assume the difference of two bags was discarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the two-bag difference from delivery has an unconfirmed location and is not necessarily discarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 在庫と、販売以外の記録があるか照合します。持ち帰り希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will match stock and any non-sales records. Do you want to take them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残っていれば持ち帰りたいです。ただ、在庫の確認前に精算額を二袋分増やしてほしいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在庫なら回収希望だが精算額加算を求めていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they remain, yes. But I am not asking for the settlement amount to be increased by two bags before stock is checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect remaining stock but are not asking to add it to the settlement amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 総額、精算額、残りの商品を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain total sales, settlement amount and remaining goods separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。報告の十袋と納品十二袋を照合し、明細を確認して受け取り方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 販売納品精算在庫の記録を照合して受取方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will match the reported ten bags with the twelve delivered, check the statement and decide how to receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match sales, delivery, settlement and stock records and decide receipt arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者と記録を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-011-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check the records with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見たい展示の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know the name of the exhibition you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この展示です。検索で見た赤い入口へ来ましたが、ポスターがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入口写真と展示場所の食い違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-02.translation: This exhibition. I came to the red entrance I saw in a search, but there is no poster.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the mismatch between the entrance photo and exhibition location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示名は合っています。ただ、この写真は前回の会場です。今回の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-03.translation: The exhibition name is correct, but this photo is of the previous venue. Do you have this event's guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約メールがあります。写真より、メールに書かれた今回の棟名を確かめてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回の予約メールの棟名を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the booking email. Rather than the photo, could you check the current building name written in the email?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the building name in the current booking email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回は別の棟です。今いる入口からは、館外の通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-05.translation: This time it is another building. From this entrance, use the outdoor passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 館内でつながっていると思っていました。一度外へ出て、どの表示を目印に進めばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 館外へ出る経路と目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought they connected inside. After going outside, which sign should I use as a landmark?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the outdoor route and landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図のこの棟名を見てください。途中の別展示の列には並ばなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-07.translation: Look for this building name on the map. You do not need to join the queue for another exhibition along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示名だけの看板で判断せず、棟名も照合します。予約画面は閉じない方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棟名を照合し予約画面の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will match the building name too, rather than judge only by a sign with the exhibition name. Should I keep the booking screen open?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the building name and ask what to do with the booking screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入場時の確認方法は会場係が案内します。今の画面に予約番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-09.translation: Venue staff will explain how to check in. Does the current screen have your booking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、番号もあります。今回の棟へ向かい、そこでこの予約画面を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約番号を示し今回の会場で確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, it has the number too. I will go to this event's building and show this booking screen there.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the booking number and say you will confirm at the current venue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この案内図も持っていってください。入口で会場係に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-012-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take this map too. You can check with venue staff at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お飲み物をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水を一本ください。残ったパンを池の鳥にあげてから、自分も休もうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水の購入と鳥への餌やり予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-02.translation: One bottle of water, please. I plan to give my leftover bread to the pond birds, then rest myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to buy water and plan to feed birds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鳥への餌やりについては、公園の掲示を確認してください。ここで買った物も餌用としては案内していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-03.translation: Check the park notices about feeding birds. We do not recommend items bought here as bird feed either.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鳥用のパンを売っているわけではないのですね。持参したパンもまだ出さず、掲示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 販売品は餌用ではないと確認し掲示を見ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-04.translation: So you are not selling bread for birds. I will keep my own bread put away for now and check the notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the goods are not bird feed and say you will check the notices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の休憩場所なら、向こうのベンチの周辺を案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-05.translation: For your own rest, I can direct you to the benches over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンを食べるのは自分だけにします。袋の切れ端を飛ばさずに置ける場所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の食事と袋が飛ぶ問題を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only I will eat the bread. Is it somewhere I can put things without pieces of the bag blowing away?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss your own meal and the problem of bags blowing away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 風があるので、袋は手元にまとめてください。ベンチの空き状況は行って確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is wind, so keep the bags together close to you. Check whether a bench is available when you get there.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 席を先に確保したことにはせず、空いていなければ別の場所を探します。ごみ箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席の空きは未確認と認めごみ箱を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not treat a seat as already secured. If none is free, I will look elsewhere. Is there a trash bin?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that seat availability is unconfirmed and ask about bins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この売店の外にはありません。持ち帰れる袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is none outside this shop. Do you have a bag to take your waste home?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 買い物袋があります。水だけ購入し、パンの袋も自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水だけ買い包装を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a shopping bag. I will buy only water and take the bread wrapping home myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy only water and take the packaging home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 水はこちらです。休憩前に公園の掲示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-013-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the water. Check the park notices before resting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 最初に見たい動物はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there an animal you want to see first?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この動物です。去年の地図の丸印へ行けば見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 去年の地図で当日の展示を判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-02.translation: This animal. Can I see it by going to the circle on last year's map?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether last year's map can determine today's display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その地図だけでは今日の展示場所や公開状況は分かりません。入口の当日案内を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-03.translation: That map alone cannot tell us today's exhibit location or viewing status. Let us look at today's entrance information together.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 丸印は自分で去年付けたものです。今日の表示を基準に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丸印が私的記録だと説明し当日案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-04.translation: I drew the circle myself last year. I would like to check using today's display.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the circle is a personal record and ask for today's guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この表示では、その展示について係員への確認が必要になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-05.translation: This display says staff confirmation is needed for that exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 場所が移ったという意味なのか、今日は見られないのかを、担当の方に聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示の意味を担当者に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you ask the person responsible whether that means it moved or cannot be seen today?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to confirm the display's meaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここから担当へ確認します。返事を待つ間に、ほかに見たい展示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check from here. While we wait, is there another exhibit you want to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 爬虫類も見たいです。ただ、確認前に遠い方へ歩き始めると戻るのが大変なので、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の希望を伝え確認まで入口で待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-08.translation: Reptiles too. But if I start walking far away before confirmation, returning will be difficult, so I will wait here.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give another preference and decide to wait at the entrance until confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。まず担当の案内を直接聞ける場所へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked. First I will guide you somewhere you can hear directly from the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、動物が必ず見られると友人にはまだ伝えず、案内を聞いてから最初の行き先を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観覧可能とはまだ伝えず案内後に経路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will not tell my friend yet that the animal is definitely viewable. I will decide where to go first after hearing the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not yet claim viewing is possible; decide the route after guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。去年の地図も比較用に持ったまま、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-014-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Bring last year's map for comparison and come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびを避ける必要があります。この焼き魚にはえびが入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避ける食材と候補料理を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to avoid shrimp. Does this grilled fish contain shrimp?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the ingredient you must avoid and your candidate dish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理担当に確認します。ほかの料理と一緒に召し上がる予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the cooking staff. Will you eat it together with other dishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人はえび料理を頼みます。同じ取り箸で大皿から分ける予定でした。そのことも確認に関係しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の料理との取り箸共有予定を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend will order a shrimp dish. We planned to share from a platter using the same serving chopsticks. Is that relevant to the check too?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Disclose the plan to share serving chopsticks with your friend's dish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 材料だけでなく、調理や取り分けの状況も伝えて確認します。安全だとここで断言はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the cooking and serving circumstances as well as ingredients when checking. I cannot declare it safe here.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では焼き魚をすぐ注文せず、共有する予定も含めて担当の説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文を保留し共有条件を含む説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not immediately order the grilled fish; I want to hear the responsible person's explanation including our plan to share.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold the order and ask for an explanation including the sharing conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が来るまでお待ちください。避ける必要があるものは、えびだけと伺ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-07.translation: Wait until the person responsible arrives. May I understand that shrimp is the only thing you must avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で範囲を省かず、医療機関から伝えられた内容をこのメモで説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己判断で範囲を縮めず手元の指示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will explain the medical institution's instructions using this note, without narrowing the scope myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your instructions without reducing their scope on your own judgment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモを担当に見せてください。説明を聞いてから注文するか決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show the note to the person responsible. You can decide whether to order after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にも取り分けを始めないよう伝えます。メモを見せ、対応の範囲を聞いてから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の取り分けも止め対応確認後に判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my friend not to begin sharing either. I will show the note and decide after hearing what arrangements are possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will also stop your friend serving food and decide after checking arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。調理担当を呼びますので、まだご注文は確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-015-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will call the cooking staff; the order is not confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料金表示のどの部分についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the price display is your question about?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初回は安いとあります。この映画館は初めてなので、買った券もその価格になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初回料金を初来店者の価格か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says the first showing is cheaper. This is my first visit to this cinema, so does my purchased ticket also get that price?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether first-showing pricing is a first-visit customer price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の初回は、今日最初の上映を指します。初めて来たお客様という意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, first means today's first screening. It does not mean a customer's first visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の券は午後の回です。初来店なら昼の回も割引になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後券で来店歴による割引と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-04.translation: My ticket is for an afternoon screening. I thought a first visit meant even a daytime showing was discounted.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you have an afternoon ticket and thought the discount depended on visit history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 午後の券は表示の通常料金です。今日の最初の回はすでに終わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-05.translation: The afternoon ticket is the displayed regular price. Today's first screening has already finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。終了した回へ変更して差額を返してもらうという依頼はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初の回は終了と理解し過去回への変更返金を求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not ask to change to a finished screening and have the difference refunded.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand the first screening is over and do not ask for a change and refund to a past showing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の午後の回は、そのままご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you keep your current afternoon screening?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この時刻で予定を組んでいます。割引を使うためだけに今の券を取り消して、明日の券を買う予定もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午後予定を維持し明日券への取消買直しもしないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I have planned around this time. I also do not plan to cancel this ticket and buy one for tomorrow just to get the discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the afternoon plans and say you will not cancel and repurchase for tomorrow either. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明日以降の料金を確認する場合は、その日の上映案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-09.translation: For prices tomorrow onward, look at each day's screening guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は購入済みの午後の券を使います。次回は来店回数でなく上映回の条件を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存券を使い次回は上映回の料金条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today I will use the afternoon ticket I already bought. Next time I will check screening conditions rather than the number of visits.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use your existing ticket and check screening-based price conditions next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。午後の上映場所はこちらの案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-016-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Check the afternoon screening location in this guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試聴された商品をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like the item you listened to?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 曲名が同じなので、値段の低いこちらにも今の演奏が入っていると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同曲名の廉価商品を同音源と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-02.translation: The song title is the same, so I thought this cheaper one included the performance I just heard too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a cheaper item with the same song title had the same recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは同じ曲のライブ版です。試聴した方はスタジオで録音した版です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a live version of the same song. The one you listened to was recorded in a studio.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 曲名だけで同じ音源とは限らないのですね。今日聞いた演奏の方を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ライブとスタジオの違いを理解し試聴演奏を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the same title does not necessarily mean the same recording. I want the performance I heard today.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the live-studio distinction and request the performance you previewed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 試聴番号と収録一覧を確認しましょう。どの曲の演奏が気に入りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the listening number and track listing. Which song's performance did you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三曲目です。曲名だけでなく、試聴した商品の番号もメモに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 気に入った曲と商品番号を併せて記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-06.translation: The third track. I will note the number of the item I listened to as well as the song title.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record both the track you liked and the product number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この番号の商品には、そのスタジオ版が入っています。別の限定盤とは付属品が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-07.translation: The product with this number contains that studio version. It has different extras from the other limited edition.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 付属品は不要です。演奏が同じなら通常盤を希望します。限定盤の写真で選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音源を優先し付属品不要で通常盤を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not need extras. If the performance is the same, I want the regular edition. I will not choose from the limited edition's photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize the recording and request the regular edition without extras. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通常盤の収録内容と価格はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the regular edition's contents and price.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。三曲目のスタジオ版がある通常盤を一枚買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収録版を確認して通常盤一枚を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked. I will buy one regular edition containing the studio version of track three.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the recording version and confirm one regular edition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その番号の商品をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-017-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will prepare the item with that number.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その容器は試用の見本です。

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さいので旅行用の商品だと思いました。これを一つ買いたかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試用見本を旅行用販売品と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is small, so I thought it was a travel-size product. I wanted to buy one.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook a tester for a travel-size sale item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 販売用は別です。持ち帰り用の小さいサイズをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sale items are separate. Do you want a small size to take home?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ただ、色もまだ決めていません。この見本を顔へ直接付けて試してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小サイズ希望と未決定色を示し試用方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. But I have not chosen a color yet either. May I apply this tester directly to my face?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your small-size preference and undecided color, and ask how to test it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 試用の方法は担当者がご案内します。共用の容器を直接お使いになる前にお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will explain testing. Please wait before directly using the shared container.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。旅行サイズの在庫と、色を試す方法は別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在庫確認と安全な試用手順を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would like to check travel-size stock and the way to test colors separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to separate stock checks from safe testing procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へつなぎます。この場面では腕の小さい範囲で試す用具をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the person responsible. In this situation, we provide tools to test on a small part of your arm.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。顔につけた時も必ず同じ見え方だとは決めず、まず色の候補を比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 腕での色確認を顔の見え方保証と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will compare possible colors first, without assuming they will look exactly the same on my face.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish checking color on your arm from a guarantee of its appearance on your face. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補が決まったら、販売サイズをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you choose a candidate, we will show you the sizes for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。見本は戻し、色を選んでから持帰り用の商品のサイズを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本を持帰らず色決定後に販売サイズを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will return the tester, choose a color, then decide the size of the take-home product.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not take the tester home; choose a sale size after deciding the color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当がご案内します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-018-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person responsible will assist you. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この通知のどの部分を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of this notice would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類が足りないとあります。もう不承認になったので、新しい申請を最初から出すしかないですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不足通知を最終不承認と思ったと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says documents are missing. Does that mean I have already been rejected and must submit a new application from the beginning?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your assumption that a missing-document notice was a final rejection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不足の案内と、審査の最終結果は分けて確認します。通知に申請番号がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the missing-document guidance separately from the final review result. The notice has an application number.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。追加書類の期限もありますが、不承認の理由だと思って読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申請番号と追加期限があると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. There is also a deadline for additional documents, but I was reading it as the reason for rejection.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that there are an application number and an additional-document deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ現在の状態を照会しましょう。同じ申請へ追加できるかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the person responsible about the current status. We will also check whether documents can be added to the same application.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。二件目として同じ内容を出さず、今の申請番号を使って相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複申請せず既存番号で状態確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to consult using my current application number, without submitting the same contents as a second application.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check status under the existing number without a duplicate application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加の対象は、この欄の書類です。ほかの書類まで全部取り直すかは決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-07.translation: The additional documents are those in this field. Do not decide to obtain every other document again too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。手元の資料で足りるかも確認します。新しい日付の物が必要か、自分では判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象書類と日付条件を担当へ確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will also check whether the materials I have are sufficient. I will not decide myself whether newer-dated ones are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the required documents and date conditions with the person responsible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が対象と期限をご案内します。通知は全体を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will explain the required items and deadline. Please show the entire notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。最終結果と決めず、追加する物と同じ申請への出し方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加内容と既存申請への提出方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not treat it as a final result; I will check what to add and how to submit it to the same application.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check additional contents and submission methods for the existing application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-019-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the person responsible on that basis.
